description: Removes one saved campaign email from the builder's list, as Remove does; campaigns that already used it keep their own copy. saved_email_id comes from read campaigns' saved_emails. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: delete_saved_campaign_email
title: Remove a saved campaign email
